firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Per Kaggle Competition Foundational Rule 6b, sharing the code behind my Paper Track writeup: https://github.com/sylvite/gemma-4-dev-agent-competition (Apache 2.0).

It contains the analysis scripts, the evaluation and gold-check kernels, the task-id splits, a run log, and the agent configuration as a diff against the organizers’ sample. The README maps each number in the paper to the script that produces it. No task text, gold patches, hidden-test contents or traces are included. Per-experiment notes are withheld until they can be redacted for competition data.
